blocks.text: Baby Poco is BACK with NEW Faces! Following the success of its first wave that became an instant hit and sold out in just three (3) months, Potato Corner is bringing back its adorable Baby Poco Blind Box with five new designs for fans to collect, unbox, and enjoy. The Baby Poco Wave 2 Blind Box features five mega-dorable new personalities — Laugh Cry Poco, Pleading Poco, Anxious Poco, Eyeroll Poco, and Blow a Kiss Poco. Each Baby Poco comes with its own unique expression and personality, making every unboxing a fun surprise and giving fans more reasons to collect them […]...
